description: Header file defining data structures, enums, and function prototypes for a QR Code generator library in C, including encoding, segment creation, and QR code data extraction.

methods.name: qrcodegen_encodeText
methods.description: Encodes a UTF-8 string into a QR code with specified error correction level and mask, returning success status.

methods.name: qrcodegen_encodeBinary
methods.description: Encodes binary data into a QR code with specified error correction level and mask, returning success status.

methods.name: qrcodegen_isAlphanumeric
methods.description: Checks if a string can be encoded in alphanumeric mode.

methods.name: qrcodegen_isNumeric
methods.description: Checks if a string can be encoded in numeric mode.

methods.name: qrcodegen_calcSegmentBufferSize
methods.description: Calculates the buffer size needed for a segment with given mode and character count.

methods.name: qrcodegen_makeBytes
methods.description: Creates a data segment from binary data in byte mode.

methods.name: qrcodegen_makeNumeric
methods.description: Creates a numeric mode segment from a digit string.

methods.name: qrcodegen_makeAlphanumeric
methods.description: Creates an alphanumeric mode segment from a text string.

methods.name: qrcodegen_makeEci
methods.description: Creates an ECI mode segment with a specified assignment value.

methods.name: qrcodegen_encodeSegments
methods.description: Encodes multiple data segments into a QR code with specified error correction level.

methods.name: qrcodegen_encodeSegmentsAdvanced
methods.description: Encodes multiple data segments with detailed parameters into a QR code.

methods.name: qrcodegen_getSize
methods.description: Returns the size (side length) of a QR code.

methods.name: qrcodegen_getModule
methods.description: Returns the color (black/white) of a specific module in the QR code.
